Section 6.4 says: 'If EXISTS, identify tests and remove it from implementation batches.' So every EXISTS row names the test that would fail if the capability regressed — an EXISTS with no test is an unfalsifiable claim, and this generator EXITS NONZERO rather than emit one. CONTRADICTED is used where the blueprint asserts a CONFIRMED gap that measurably shipped in new13/new14; grading those ABSENT would re-authorize building what already exists, which is the exact waste Blueprint v1.4 line 216 forbids. In the do-not-build bucket, ABSENT is the PASSING state and any EXISTS would be a defect.
